name: Clay Pipe Forming
mechanism: Shape continuous hollow clay sections with controlled walls and open ends.
operating_requirement: Suitable prepared clay, water, forming supports, drying space, potters and elapsed workshop time.
consequence: Produces unfired conduit sections; malformed or cracked sections consume labor and clay without usable installed capacity.
scope_boundary: A formed hollow section is a different product from a pot, brick, pressure joint or completed drainage network.
branching_note: All listed mandatory foundations and one member of each alternative group are needed. These are proposed causal requirements, not date or civilization gates.
recovery: Pay an available specialist for delivered plans or instruction, or contribute to joint trials; local crews still demonstrate this exact operation with local materials. Imported finished pipes can supply a project without granting manufacturing mastery.

name: Ceramic Pipe Firing Qualification
mechanism: Compare fired conduit batches for warping, absorption and fracture under declared service conditions.
operating_requirement: Actual dried pipe sections, kiln volume, fuel, firing labor and sacrificed test pieces.
consequence: Releases a bounded batch of fired pipe for suitable service; poor firing raises rejection and repair demand. Early fired clay does not automatically gain modern vitrified-pipe performance.
scope_boundary: Qualifies the long hollow product and its losses; generic kiln control alone does not certify a usable pipe batch.

name: Conduit Infiltration Testing
mechanism: Compare water gained or lost across an isolated installed conduit section under recorded conditions.
operating_requirement: Reachable test ends, closures, water observations, measurement time and a crew able to distinguish leakage from storage change.
consequence: Locates sections needing further investigation and prevents untested sections being treated as tight; consumes inspection time without automatically locating every individual defect.
scope_boundary: Section acceptance differs from network-wide water_leak_balances and from testing pipe material before installation.
